name: graph-paper
title: Graph Paper
description: Engineering graph paper: fine squares with a stronger line every few cells, fading out towards the edges.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of one small square, in pixels.

props.name: majorEvery
props.description: Every n-th line is drawn stronger. Use 0 to draw only the small grid.

props.name: fade
props.description: Fades the grid out towards the edges.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the layer. Place it absolutely behind your content.
